mapper.select: SELECT UNIT_ID, BLDG_ID, RENTAL_PTY_ID, MOVE_IN_DT, MOVE_OUT_DT, MBR_CD, UNIT_DEL_YN FROM UNIT_RESIDENT WHERE BLDG_ID = #{bldgId} AND UNIT_DEL_YN = 'N' ORDER BY UNIT_ID
SELECT MBR_CD, MBR_ID, MBR_NM, MBR_TELNO FROM MEMBER WHERE MBR_STATUS_CODE = 'ACTIVE' AND ( MBR_ID LIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%' OR MBR_NM LIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%' )

SELECT BLDG_ID, RENTAL_PTY_ID, BLDG_NM, BLDG_ADDR, BLDG_DTL_ADDR, BLDG_TYPE_CODE, BLDG_CMPLTN_DT, BLDG_GROSS_AREA, DEL_YN FROM BUILDING WHERE RENTAL_PTY_ID = #{rentalPtyId} AND DEL_YN = 'N' ORDER BY BLDG_NM ASC

SELECT u.UNIT_ID, u.BLDG_ID, u.RENTAL_PTY_ID, u.UNIT_ROOM, u.UNIT_FLR_NO, u.UNIT_STAT_CD, ur.MBR_CD, ur.MOVE_IN_DT, ur.MOVE_OUT_DT, ur.UNIT_DEL_YN, m.MBR_NM, m.MBR_ID, m.MBR_TELNO FROM UNIT u LEFT OUTER JOIN UNIT_RESIDENT ur ON u.UNIT_ID = ur.UNIT_ID AND u.BLDG_ID = ur.BLDG_ID AND u.RENTAL_PTY_ID = ur.RENTAL_PTY_ID AND ur.UNIT_DEL_YN = 'N' LEFT OUTER JOIN MEMBER m ON ur.MBR_CD = m.MBR_CD WHERE u.BLDG_ID = #{bldgId} ORDER BY u.UNIT_ID, ur.MBR_CD

SELECT u.UNIT_ID, u.BLDG_ID, u.RENTAL_PTY_ID, u.UNIT_ROOM, u.UNIT_FLR_NO, u.UNIT_STAT_CD, ur.MBR_CD, ur.MOVE_IN_DT, ur.MOVE_OUT_DT, ur.UNIT_DEL_YN, m.MBR_NM, m.MBR_ID, m.MBR_TELNO, b.BLDG_NM FROM UNIT u LEFT OUTER JOIN UNIT_RESIDENT ur ON u.UNIT_ID = ur.UNIT_ID AND u.BLDG_ID = ur.BLDG_ID AND u.RENTAL_PTY_ID = ur.RENTAL_PTY_ID AND ur.UNIT_DEL_YN = 'N' LEFT OUTER JOIN MEMBER m ON ur.MBR_CD = m.MBR_CD LEFT OUTER JOIN BUILDING b ON u.BLDG_ID = b.BLDG_ID WHERE u.RENTAL_PTY_ID = #{rentalPtyId} ORDER BY u.UNIT_ID, ur.MBR_CD

SELECT u.UNIT_ID as unitId, u.BLDG_ID as bldgId, u.UNIT_ROOM as unitRoom FROM UNIT u LEFT JOIN UNIT_RESIDENT r ON u.UNIT_ID = r.UNIT_ID AND u.BLDG_ID = r.BLDG_ID AND r.UNIT_DEL_YN = 'N' WHERE u.BLDG_ID = #{bldgId} AND (r.UNIT_ID IS NULL)

SELECT u.UNIT_ID, u.BLDG_ID, u.RENTAL_PTY_ID, u.UNIT_ROOM, u.UNIT_FLR_NO, u.UNIT_STAT_CD, ur.MBR_CD, ur.MOVE_IN_DT, ur.MOVE_OUT_DT, ur.UNIT_DEL_YN, m.MBR_NM, m.MBR_ID, m.MBR_TELNO, u.MBR_CD AS UNIT_MASTER, CASE WHEN u.MBR_CD = 'master' AND ur.MBR_CD IS NOT NULL THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END AS IS_MASTER FROM UNIT u LEFT OUTER JOIN UNIT_RESIDENT ur ON u.UNIT_ID = ur.UNIT_ID AND u.BLDG_ID = ur.BLDG_ID AND u.RENTAL_PTY_ID = ur.RENTAL_PTY_ID AND (ur.UNIT_DEL_YN = 'N' OR ur.UNIT_DEL_YN IS NULL) LEFT OUTER JOIN MEMBER m ON ur.MBR_CD = m.MBR_CD WHERE u.BLDG_ID = #{bldgId} ORDER BY u.UNIT_ID, ur.MBR_CD
